query_original: How many points does the winner of a Formula 1 race receive, and does the full amount always apply regardless of how much of the race is completed?
query_reformulada: What are the championship point allocations for the winner of an FIA Formula One World Championship event, and do these allocations remain unchanged even if the scheduled distance or duration of the event is not fully completed?
resposta: The winner of a Formula 1 race receives 25 points. However, this amount does not always apply regardless of how much of the race is completed. According to Article A2.1, if less than 25% of the Scheduled Race Distance has been completed by the leader, points will be awarded in accordance with column 1 of the table below, which may be fewer than 25 points.
